name: Snowflake Glaze Ceramic Tea Ensemble
marketing_tip: The unique crystalline texture of the snowflake glaze adds a layer of visual poetry to your tea table.
body: Featuring a beautiful snowflake glaze, this one-pot six-cup set captures the fleeting beauty of winter frost. The textured surface provides a comfortable grip and a stunning visual contrast to the tea inside.
original_title: 厂家1壶6杯雪花釉茶具套装功夫茶具陶瓷茶壶茶杯批发定LOGO礼盒装
